note: T2 Hedge Maze surveil, hand Strand, 2 Misty, Brainstorm, Stock Up, Aluren, Acererak: kept a second Stock Up on top. Aluren and Acererak were already in hand and the hand lacked a 4th mana (Tomb/Petal/City); the Stock Up could not be cast before the combo turn and never was. Binning it gives a fresh draw (about 1 in 6 mana source). Brainstorm happened to find Tomb.

Keep on the draw (opponent unknown): Hedge Maze, Flooded Strand, 2 Misty, Brainstorm, Stock Up, Aluren. No creature, no Force, no fast mana. Kept; drew Acererak on T2 and won T6, but it needed Brainstorm to find Ancient Tomb. Playbook says a creature in the seven matters more than cantrips.

B's T5 end step, Flooded Strand search: took Savannah over Hedge Maze. Maze gives the same G for Aluren, also U, enters tapped harmlessly at end step and surveils (existing playbook rule t22/t25). No impact this game.

T5 Boros, 3 mana, hand Swords, Ajani, Amped Raptor, Spider-Woman, A on 2 lands with 7 cards: cast Ajani and held W for Swords rather than tapping out (Spider-Woman) or Raptor plus 1. The held Swords was the only answer to the T6 Acererak loop; worth confirming this is the standard hold against Aluren.
